title: Put residential building contracts in writing
what: Put each home building work contract in writing, setting out all its terms and its date, signed by the builder and the owner, and give the owner the prescribed explanatory notice.

sources.title: Home Building Contracts Act 1991 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A contract — (a) must be in writing — (i) setting out all of the terms, conditions and provisions of the contract; and (ii) showing the date of the contract; and (b) must be signed by the builder and the owner or their respective agents
